domains.label: Friends & family
domains.goal: Distinguish kinship terms, affectionate address and close-friend vocabulary.

domains.goal: Focus on high-frequency interaction patterns that make speech sound locally natural.

domains.goal: Teach verbs and expressions used to coordinate plans, help others and react in conversation.

domains.goal: Cover everyday food, shopping and market interactions.

domains.goal: Teach praise, criticism and personality descriptions with strong register warnings where needed.

domains.goal: Preserve Andean cultural vocabulary while clearly marking what is shared beyond Ecuador.

domains.label: Style & appearance
domains.goal: Capture natural everyday expressions around clothing and appearance.
